training_data.name: Mental Health Chatbot Dataset
training_data.quote: This dataset contains conversational pair of questions and answers in a single text related to Mental Health. Dataset was curated from popular healthcare blogs like WebMD, Mayo Clinic and HeatlhLine, online FAQs etc.

training_method.objective_quote: Fine-tuned with a causal language modeling objective

description.text: This model is a fine-tuned version of Meta's LLaMA 2 7B, specifically designed for mental health-focused conversational applications. It provides empathetic, supportive, and informative responses related to mental well-being. LLaMA-2-7B-Mental-Chat is optimized for natural language conversations in mental health contexts. Fine-tuned on a curated dataset of mental health dialogues, it aims to assist with stress management, general well-being, and providing empathetic support.

output_type.quote: specifically designed for mental health-focused conversational applications.

use_claim.quote: Mental Health Chatbot: For providing empathetic, non-clinical support on mental health topics like anxiety, stress, and general well-being.

warning.quote: Not a substitute for professional mental health care.

serving.text_only_input_quote: input_text = "I feel overwhelmed and anxious. What should I do?"
serving.notes: The card example calls model.generate with max_length=200. tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key. Its model_max_length is an overflow value, not a context length. The card also says the weights are 10.5 GB in two .bin files.

evaluation_reported.text: The card reports a held-out validation set of mental health dialogues, with Empathy Score 85/100, Relevance 90%, and Safety 95%. It says perplexity was lower than the base model and does not give the perplexity number.

discrepancies: Inventory methods are blank. The card states a causal language modeling fine-tune, 3 epochs, batch size 8, and learning rate 5e-6, and does not say LoRA or full. Inventory parent NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf matches the YAML and config.json up to capitalization. The card's Fine-tuned from link points at meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf.
